name: Electron Backscatter Diffraction Technique-Aligned Procedure Profile (ebsdTAPP)
abstract: Electron backscatter diffraction extension of the base TAPP definition, for ADA's SEMEBSDGrainImageMap component type. ONE laboratory instance: all 14 distinct method-description documents behind 4305 references are from Curtin University, on a Tescan MIRA3 with an Oxford Instruments AZtec v5.1 Symmetry EBSD-EDS system. The native layer is seeded from those documents rather than from ADA subject fields, which carry no EBSD-specific property at all -- the 1354 records hold only channel1-3 and imageType. Constant across all 14 and therefore protocol-level: 70 degree stage tilt, camera gain 2, a 1.2 degree maximum mean angular deviation and an XMax 150 mm SDD detector. Generated from draftTAPPs/EBSD_TAPP_draft_v2.csv by tools/build_tapp.py.
